note: One face per person for the whole film. Every shot with a person in it attaches that person's portrait, in the order listed per shot, and names them as the first/second reference image.

dealer.lock: exactly the same face, greying black hair, thick moustache and build; cream full-sleeve shirt with sleeves rolled, navy trousers, black belt, steel wristwatch

attendant.asset: attendant portrait (the one S12/S27 were made from)
attendant.lock: same face and plain grey work clothes

manager.asset: manager portrait (the one S13/S27 were made from)
manager.lock: same face, plait and maroon kurta

accountant.asset: accountant portrait (the one S44 was made from)

mdgRep.lock: same face and plain light-blue shirt
mdgRep.desc: the MDG representative, an Indian man in his late twenties, neat short hair, plain light-blue shirt, no badge, no lanyard

teamLead.asset: teamLead portrait (made from the S14 still)
teamLead.lock: same face, spectacles, greying temples and plain white shirt
teamLead.desc: the MDG team lead, an experienced Indian man about 45 with greying temples and spectacles, plain white shirt, no badge

teamMember.asset: teamMember portrait (made from the S53 still)
teamMember.lock: same face, hair and plain mustard-yellow kurta
teamMember.desc: the MDG team member, a young Indian woman about 25 in a plain mustard-yellow kurta, no badge
